prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one premium macOS application icon for a compact keyboard-first productivity utility called Ollie.
Primary request: a bold tactile desktop control switch, a single enormous vermilion-red sculptural rocker switch nested in a warm ivory ceramic rounded-square tile. The rocker is one chunky asymmetric rounded rectangular shape, pushed down at its right end so there is a crisp narrow near-black crescent of recessed space at the left. This should feel like beautifully designed industrial equipment, unusually simple and immediately recognizable.
Composition: square 1024x1024, front view with very slight top-down depth, tile centered occupying about 88% of the canvas, one icon only. Rounded-square macOS tile with generous corners. Transparent empty canvas outside the tile. Red control fills approximately 65% of the tile; short charcoal slot underneath makes depth clear.
Style: beautifully modeled product-design object, restrained 3D depth and precise edges, softly lit matte ceramic and satin lacquer, one small specular edge, high contrast. No dramatic cast shadow beyond the tile. Quiet sophisticated material, no worn texture.
Palette: warm chalk ivory, vivid tomato red, a very small near-black recess. Distinct silhouette should remain readable at 32px.
Constraints: NO lettering, NO text, NO numerals, NO on/off labels, NO lightning bolt, NO sparks, NO rings, NO app-name wordmark, no border frame, no room or desktop, no mockup presentation, no additional buttons or tools, no generic rainbow gradient, no watermark. This is the final individual icon asset, not a contact sheet.

Subject: a calm friendly sea otter, a distinctive simplified sculptural character with round head, tiny rounded ears, a large pale cream muzzle and nose, and two dark wide-set eyes. Front-facing head, shoulders and front paws visible, cradling one smooth oval grey pebble at the chest. The character fills 72% of the tile and stays completely inside it. One face only.
Style: refined matte soft-touch vinyl toy with chunky sculpted geometric forms, very few details, no individual fur strands, no human accessories, no grin, no eyebrows, no busy whisker texture. Warm chestnut body and cream muzzle, dark ink-teal tile. Soft top-left lighting with restrained depth, dark-gloss bead eyes, elegant restrained character design rather than children's cartoon. Readability comes from the big cream muzzle and simple silhouette.
